## Overview

This skill covers essential testing patterns and best practices.

## Instructions

1. Understand the testing pyramid and where unit tests fit.
2. Write tests that are readable, maintainable, and fast.
3. Use mocking carefully and only when necessary.
4. Always test edge cases and boundary conditions.
5. Refactor tests alongside production code.
6. Keep test descriptions clear and descriptive.
7. Use consistent naming conventions across test suites.
8. Organize tests by feature or module for easier navigation.
9. Avoid testing implementation details; focus on behavior.
10. Run tests frequently during development to catch regressions early.
11. Document test coverage expectations for new features.
12. Review test results after each CI build to identify flaky tests.
13. Use test fixtures to manage shared test data efficiently.
14. Prefer integration tests over unit tests when possible.
15. Consider using property-based testing for complex logic.
16. Maintain a balance between test speed and coverage depth.
17. Use assertion libraries that provide helpful error messages.
18. Keep test dependencies minimal and up to date.
19. Structure tests to fail fast on unexpected behavior.
20. Regularly audit tests to remove obsolete or redundant cases.
